meta.scope: adversarial precision attack on SmsValidationEngine (createDefaultEngine defaults)

findings.message: Từ "Pro" có thể là lỗi chính tả (gợi ý: "trở").
findings.reproText: Mua ngay iPhone 15 Pro Max giá tốt tại Tendoo Store, bảo hành chính hãng 12 tháng, freeship mọi đơn hàng!
findings.whyGenuinelyClean: "iPhone 15 Pro Max" is Apple's official product-line naming attached to a whitelisted brand term (iPhone). No whitespace/punctuation/accent issue exists anywhere in the row.
findings.rootCause: SymSpell deletion index matches short OOV loanword 'pro' to frequent lexicon key 'trở' at edit distance 1 (maxEditDistanceFor(3)=1). Context-anchor gate passes (neighbour 'iPhone' resolves via whitelist->accent candidates). LM context score for 'trở' beats the 0.8 original-prior, so softmax p=0.95 clears both gates (0.85/0.20). Note the arbitrary asymmetry: 'Max' survives (no dist<=1 lexicon twin) while 'Pro' dies.
findings.userImpact: A demo would tell a user their flagship-product sentence has a 95%-confident typo. Damages trust in the warning panel.
findings.suggestedDirection: Protect tokens adjacent to whitelisted brand terms / mixed-case CamelCase tokens ('Pro','Max') from the spelling rule, or require dist>=1 collisions against verbs to clear a higher margin when the original token starts uppercase mid-sentence.

findings.message: Từ "ngay" có thể đang thiếu dấu (gợi ý: "ngày").
findings.reproText: Giảm đến 70% toàn bộ sản phẩm... Mua ngay tại cskh@tendoo.vn hoặc link facebook.com/tendoo.vn! Số lượng có hạn.
findings.whyGenuinelyClean: 'Mua ngay tại …' is the standard marketing imperative 'buy now at'. 'ngay' (immediately) is itself a lexicon entry (freq 190000) and is correctly unaccented here; 'ngày' would be wrong.
findings.rootCause: Because 'ngay' has an accented sibling 'ngày', classifyToken routes it to UNACCENTED_VALID instead of DICTIONARY, feeding it into the contextual beam. The interpolated bigram model prefers 'ngày' between 'mua' and resolved-neighbour 'tại', clearing conf 0.7 / margin 0.2 despite the original-prior bonus. Same trigger fires in C24 ('Đặt đơn ngay tại https://…').
findings.userImpact: One of the most common phrases in Vietnamese SMS commerce ('mua ngay') gets a missing-diacritic warning whenever followed by 'tại'. High-frequency phrase => high real-world exposure.
findings.corroboration: Official benchmark's own failed rows are the mirror image (missed PMD on function words 'tai/tu/den'): the contextual ranker systematically mishandles function-word contexts.
findings.suggestedDirection: Raise evidence bar when the original form is itself dictionary-valid with high frequency (DICTIONARY-vs-UNACCENTED_VALID distinction currently collapses for 'ngay'), or add a stopword/function-word guardlist ('ngay','tu','den','tai') exempt from auto-warning.

findings.message: Từ "Hoa" có thể đang thiếu dấu (gợi ý: "hóa").
findings.reproText: Chúc mừng sinh nhật Trần Thị Hoa! Nhận ngay voucher 200.000đ dành cho bạn tại tendoo.vn/sinh-nhat. Happy birthday 🎂
findings.whyGenuinelyClean: 'Trần Thị Hoa' is a correctly-spelled Vietnamese female personal name; 'Hoa' is its canonical form. Birthday greeting content is otherwise flawless (emoji allowed per policy, URL protected, whitelist terms used).
findings.rootCause: Proper nouns are not a protected span class (only URL/email/phone/date/time/money/code/placeholder are). Capitalized-but-not-ALLCAPS tokens skip nothing: 'Hoa' enters the accent-candidate pipeline and the n-gram prefers 'hóa' after resolved 'thị'.
findings.userImpact: Addressing a customer by name is the core personalization use case of marketing SMS; flagging the recipient's own name is the most reputationally damaging FP class for this product.
findings.corroboration: Benchmark 'names-guards' category passes (fp=0) only because its 10 rows happen not to include an ambiguous given name at clause-final position.
findings.suggestedDirection: Treat TitleCase tokens following surname-pattern neighbours (Trần/Thị/Văn/Nguyễn…) as name-like and suppress PMD, or gate clause-final capitalized tokens behind higher confidence.

findings.message: Từ "ngay" có thể đang thiếu dấu (gợi ý: "ngày").
findings.reproText: [Tendoo] Chỉ còn 3 giờ! Giảm đến 50% toàn bộ iPhone, Samsung; freeship đơn từ 99.000đ. Đặt đơn ngay tại https://m.tendoo.vn/deal?utm=ny&id=8888 hoặc gọi 0987 654 321. Hẹn gặp lại!
findings.whyGenuinelyClean: Same root cause as FP-2 ('Đặt đơn ngay tại …'); row additionally stacks bracket tag, semicolon list, mobile-subdomain URL with UTM params and spaced phone number — all handled correctly, isolating 'ngay' as the sole defect.
findings.userImpact: Duplicate instance proving the pattern is systematic, not a one-off lexical accident.

debatableObservations.reproText: gặp nhau tại a.b.c của quán
debatableObservations.observed: MISSING_WHITESPACE_AFTER_PUNCTUATION x2 on the dots of 'a.b.c'
debatableObservations.whyDebatable: isInitialismNeighbourhood requires [A-Z] neighbours (punctuation-rules.mjs line 65), so lowercase initials warn. Documented behaviour promises exemption for 'A.B.C' (uppercase); lowercase initials are rare in VN marketing SMS, so excluded from the clean corpus. Not counted as an FP.

debatableObservations.reproText: Mua ngay tại shop.hanghieu.sale hoặc tendoo.store!
debatableObservations.observed: MISSING_WHITESPACE_AFTER_PUNCTUATION on every dot inside '.sale'/'.store' bare domains (KNOWN_TLDS allow-list in protected-ranges.mjs)
debatableObservations.whyDebatable: Documented behaviour guarantees protection for 'bare domains like tendoo.vn'; .shop/.store/.sale/.online are real gTLDs common in e-commerce, but the engine's design comment shows the narrow TLD list is deliberate (avoid swallowing A.B.C). Marked allowExtra-equivalent (kept out of corpus); flagged for product follow-up.

debatableObservations.reproText: Ưu đãi hết hạn vào 23:59....Đăng nhập ngay!
debatableObservations.observed: On DIRTY rows D05/D08 the engine additionally emits PMD on correct 'ngay!' at clause end (conf 0.73). Extras are ignored there by contract (allowExtra:true), so not counted, but confirms the FP-2 pattern extends beyond 'ngay tại'.
